desc: Derive and verify the segment-tree algorithm that concatenates non-deleted blocks for each distinct value.
Prove that processing blocks between occurrences exactly represents the filtered array and yields the optimal subarray sum.
Handle edge cases: no deletion, all-negative arrays, repeated values, empty blocks, and deleting the sole distinct value.
Produce and test a clean `class Solution` implementation with \(O(n\log n)\) complexity.
